(NYSE: ASPN) (“Aspen” or the “Company”), a technology leader in sustainability and electrification solutions, today announced financial results for the fourth quarter and full year 2025 and discussed recent business developments. Fourth Quarter 2025 Results Total revenue for the fourth quarter of 2025 was $41.3 million, compared to $123.1 million in the prior year period. Thermal barrier segment revenue was $16.1 million, compared to $70.0 million in the prior year period, reflecting a significant reduction in customer demand following changes in regulatory frameworks and incentive programs. The Company also expects to release its quarterly financial results before the market opens on Wednesday, February 25, 2026.
